geo_summary: Aged mice (22-24 mo) underwent Progressive weighted wheel running (PoWeR) for 8 weeks. RNA-seq on soleus and plantaris muscles was conducted on untrained and PoWeR trained mice. RNA from soleus and plantaris of young mice (4-6 months old) was used as a comparator (Englund et al. 2021 Function)
